name: valve_ep2_grub_cavern
note: Episode Two's grub cavern (styleguide_caves, Valve's own sample of an antlion cave): a chamber about 2500 by 1300 of rock (rockwall015a, blendrockdirt_tunnel02a) with a natural chimney rising to about 1920, about 56 grubs on its walls and floor with their small lights. One way in: a tunnel on its north face (y -1792, x 0 to 192, floor 0, about 252 high). Anchor: that mouth's middle on its floor. The grubs are NPCs (npc_antlion_grub), not kept by extract: placed from the source by CaveForest.
